description: We're looking for an ML engineer with experience in building scalable ML models for production using TensorFlow. Experience with large-scale data pipelines is essential.
Responsible for building big data pipelines and processing systems using Hadoop and Spark on AWS infrastructure. Work closely with data scientists and analysts.
Work on building statistical models and predictive analytics to support business decisions. Comfortable working with large datasets.
Join our AI research team to develop cutting-edge models and optimize deep learning pipelines for real-world deployment.
Build and maintain robust data pipelines that support content analytics and recommendation systems at scale.
Develop scalable infrastructure for training and deploying ML models. Collaborate with product teams to build personalized search and pricing systems.
Analyze performance data across vehicle fleets and suggest actionable improvements. Build dashboards and statistical summaries for executives.
Analyze massive data streams to improve route efficiency and ETAs. Work on pricing optimization and fraud detection systems.
Build systems to improve search ranking and relevance using user interaction data and relevance feedback loops.
Work on Oracle’s cloud-native data platform to enable scalable and secure data services. Develop infrastructure-as-code templates for automating deployments.
